project.title: CIIFR-ELEMENT
project.subtitle: WBS 4.0–4.6 · inherited evidence; engineering qualification and writer HOLD
project.aim: Expand CII Find & Replace into typed ELEMENTS values, physical Line Number labels and pointer-resolved RIGID edits. Preserve immutable originals, units, approved byte spans and existing NodeName protections; qualify engineering semantics before new-copy export.

M1.name: E0 · Architectural scope / oracle
M1.full: Lock the Owner outcome: typed ELEMENTS physical fields (53 real slots + Line Number label) and separate pointer-attached RIGID (aux pointer #2), retaining existing NodeName (ptr #12). Rehash source; enumerate v14 widths, units, sentinel semantics and record ownership; document correct and false interpretations before implementation.
M1.canDo: No editor released; prepare complete field model and contrary fixtures.
M1.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M2.name: E1 · Physical ELEMENTS / pointer map
M2.full: Ground on the 22-section original v14 fixture: 521 ELEMENTS × 15 physical lines with 53 real fields, element/line labels, appearance and 15 auxiliary pointer slots; 177 NODENAME, 156 RIGID. Produce exact field byte positions, typed names and pointer targets; separate node number vs pointer ID, reject bad sections/pointers.
M2.canDo: A read-only per-field catalogue, not inferred field names or write authority.
M2.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M3.name: E2 · Engineering numeric replacements
M3.full: Select a v14-proven real slot (ΔX/Y/Z, diameter/wall/insulation, pressure/temperature, materials as justified) and an element/branch scope. Numeric find/replace must preserve representation, known units, field-specific zero/9999.99/1E-10 policies, exponent/signed zero, width, rounding and ranges; no whole-file regex or silent normalization.
M3.canDo: One bounded field group and actual changed-byte check first.
M3.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M4.name: E3 · RIGID Weight via pointer #2
M4.full: Resolve EACH selected ELEMENTS auxiliary RIGID pointer #2 as a 1-based index in #$ RIGID. 0 means no attached record (not Weight=0). Check bounds, ownership/shared references, record field width and engineering units. Weight first; Rigid Type editing after CAESAR code semantics independently grounded; never invent/reindex pointer records.
M4.canDo: One nonzero-pointer weight edit with absent-pointer and shared-pointer negative cases.
M4.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M5.name: E4 · Physical Line Number / branch
M5.full: Treat the line-number/branch label as a serialized ELEMENTS field with length prefix and exact bytes, not a node identity. Scope by actual label and element. Rewriting line labels requires prefix/width validation and checks for cross-branch shared logical nodes; do not assume segment topology proves node ownership.
M5.canDo: Demonstrate precise label edit plus bad-length/shared-node contrast.
M5.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M6.name: E5 · Safe TARGET1 writer / engineering acceptance
M6.full: Current NodeName writer compares unchanged ELEMENTS structure; do not bypass sameStructure wholesale. New allowlist writer must verify original SHA, approved typed field spans, atomic auxiliary owner/alias closure, all other bytes unchanged, pointer targets/cardinality unchanged, fresh epoch, reparse and final hash. Independent wrong-field/unit challenge + native CAESAR import before semantic PASS.
M6.canDo: PASS only exact candidate/source/version and executed gates; approvals are not release.
M6.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

M7.name: E6 · Structural operations deferred
M7.full: FROM/TO are graph endpoint node numbers (not pointers); renumbering affects every incident element and name. Pointer creation/reindexing changes indexed auxiliary sections and cardinalities. Both require separate Owner GO, graph-atomic contract and fixtures. P3 remains deferred. Planning does not unlock E6.
M7.canDo: Explicit HOLD until a new Owner-controlled engineering work packet.
M7.activity: Inherited roadmap; no new engineering acceptance

main.title: WBS4 E0/E1 · CII architecture + physical oracle
main.sub: Owner intent, ELEMENTS 15-line/53-real layout, named nodes vs indexed auxiliary pointers, field-specific sentinels; exact byte-span fixture and wrong-case contracts.

editors.title: WBS4 E2/E3/E4 · Typed field transactions
editors.sub: ELEMENTS numeric slots and physical branch text are edited at element level; RIGID Weight/Type is auxiliary pointer #2 data, never guessed from node number or alias.

verification.title: WBS4 E5/E6 · Writer protection / structural HOLD
verification.sub: Only approved field spans in immutable TARGET1; independent pointer/alias/unit/byte falsification and CAESAR import. Endpoint renumber/pointer rebuild remain Owner-held.

revisions.why: Owner requested a dedicated CIIFR-ELEMENT WBS. Preserve CIIFR R4 history; this projection creates no product release, agent assignment or Oracle control cutover.
